CollectionSetting.description: Whether the VTA collects by default for the identifiers of one trust context that no client has claimed (VTI-NTF-094 – VTI-NTF-098), and who last changed that. The VTA collects for them exactly when `collectByDefault` is true and `suspendedByOperator` is false. `changedBy` and `changedAt` are present together, and both absent while the setting has never been changed.

changedBy.description: The subject of the access control entry that last changed `collectByDefault` (VTI-NTF-096).

collectByDefault.description: The context's own setting: true unless a party with administrative authority over the context has disabled it (VTI-NTF-094, VTI-NTF-095). The VTA keeps it across restarts.

contextId.description: The trust context the setting belongs to. It applies to that context's identifiers alone, not to its ancestors' or descendants' (VTI-NTF-094).

suspendedByOperator.description: Whether the VTA's operator has suspended collection by default for every context (VTI-NTF-098). While true, the VTA collects for no unclaimed identifier here whatever `collectByDefault` says, and does not change it; once lifted, `collectByDefault` applies again. Always false at a VTA that offers its operator no suspension.

schema.description: A client with administrative authority over a trust context enables or disables collection by default there: whether its VTA collects for the context's identifiers that no client has claimed (VTI-NTF-094, VTI-NTF-095). The VTA stores the setting, applies it before it answers — disabling it stops collection and closes the VTA's connections for those identifiers — and records the change in its audit trail (VTI-NTF-096). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

collectByDefault.description: true to enable collection by default for the context, false to disable it.

contextId.description: The trust context whose setting to change. The change applies to that context's identifiers alone, not to its ancestors' or descendants' (VTI-NTF-094).
